verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs say a card can be frozen instantly from Cards in the app, and a replacement ordered there, typically arriving in 5–7 business days. Relay also issues physical and virtual Visa cards to team members. Both parts of the story are covered, but only by a single first-party line. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the freeze/replace flow (e.g., whether a finance lead can freeze team members' cards, whether a virtual card is available instantly as a stopgap, whether a freeze can be undone), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
